newsitem.title: USA: Hospitality enters hotel joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Hospitality enters hotel joint venture.

text.p: Hospitality Worldwide Services Inc said on Tuesday it entered into a joint venture with Apollo Real Estate Advisors II LP and Watermark Investments Ltd LLC to acquire, renovate and resell hotel properties.

The companies said they believe that nationwide, market values for full-service hotels have yet to exceed replacement costs, creating opportunity to renovate existing hotels and to convert other property types.

Apollo is general partner of a group of real estate investment funds. Watermark is an international management company. Hospitality provides interior and exterior cosmetic renovation, refurbishment and maintenance services for the hospitality industry.
